summary: The prepared base already gates disposal of the standard DeepGEMM pre-permute input on runner_config.inplace in both compact and masked layouts. Added a four-case regression that fails when unconditional disposal is restored and passes against the checked-out implementation.

tests.command: rocm-smi --showproductname --showuniqueid --showmeminfo vram; /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-752f67c926d3/venv/bin/python <GPU probe and DeepGEMM import script>
tests.what_was_measured: Detected the single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, one available GPU, successful GPU arithmetic (sum 66.0), and import of the checked-out deep_gemm.py. Raw output: reports/j-752f67c926d3/raw/gpu_and_import.txt

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-752f67c926d3/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/layers/moe/test_deep_gemm_standard_input_ownership.py -vv (with both ownership guards temporarily removed)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: compact and masked inplace=False cases both observed the caller alias collapse from shape [4, 4] to [0]; inplace=True boundary cases passed. Raw output: reports/j-752f67c926d3/raw/regression_before.txt
Passing-after regression on gfx950: all four compact/masked and borrowed/owned ownership cases passed against the prepared source. Raw output: reports/j-752f67c926d3/raw/regression_final.txt
Delivered test and report changes contain no whitespace errors.

gpu_execution.evidence: Regression tensors and alias/storage assertions executed on the assigned single AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 through torch device 'cuda'; hardware and framework details are in reports/j-752f67c926d3/raw/gpu_and_import.txt.

remaining_limitations: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8 weights and the reported eight-H800 TP8/EP8 CUDA environment were unavailable, so no full-model or multi-node serving reproduction was performed.
The regression executes the actual Python pre-permute implementation but mocks token packing kernels to isolate the ownership contract; it is not a DeepGEMM numerical correctness test.
The prepared source already contained the correction, so the delivered code change is regression coverage and evidence rather than a new production fix.
